# Frozen archive of version @VERSION@ — archive figée de la version @VERSION@

**English** · **Français**

## English

The **same 21 files** as [desktop-latest](https://github.com/zigmoon/SUPERPRINT/releases/tag/desktop-latest),
but these **will never be replaced again** — this is where version @VERSION@ is kept, for good.
The 21 files are attached to this release, and `SHA256SUMS` holds the checksum of each of them.

- **Newer versions** — <https://github.com/zigmoon/SUPERPRINT/releases/tag/desktop-latest>
- **Contact** — <contact@superprint.cc>
